message.content:
This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a large humanoid figure whose massive head and clenched fists rest on a checkered, brown-and-orange wooden floor. This giant has tan skin with stippled shading, dark hair swept to one side, and closed, squinting eyes. His mouth is open, revealing two rows of white teeth. Five small human figures in uniform—wearing light blue, tan, or white shirts and dark pants—stand on the checkered tiles around his face and fists. Some point or look into his open mouth, while another crouches nearby. In the lower right corner, a small figure in white robes and a turban lies on the floor, holding a smartphone.

Large white block letters at the bottom left read “SALING-SILANG SOAL RIZIEQ.” Below this, smaller white text describes differing stances of police, military, and government bodies. At the top, white text reads “SEBELUM CHAIRUL TANJUNG MENJEJAK PATIMBAN” and “WAWANCARA KHUSUS JUSUF KALLA.” The background is a dark blue pattern. A red border runs along the left side, and a barcode and QR code appear at the bottom left.
